capacity_mw.note: Provo staff report says power usage would be 5-50 MW as it becomes available from Provo Power and more would require code changes; the required overlay was denied, so this is not an approved/live capacity.

contradictions.description: A Utah government inventory retained from the baseline listed the project as under construction at 5-30 MW, while later/retrieved Provo official records show the required local data-center overlay failed 0:7 on 2026-03-10. The Provo local entitlement record is treated as authoritative for current status.

Baseline inventory gave a 5-30 MW range; Provo staff materials and subsequent local reporting describe 5-50 MW as a proposed power-use scale. Because the overlay was denied, neither figure is treated as approved or operational capacity.
